authority.statement: Replace the independent human architect review step for this frozen P3.3-S6 pairing-v3 candidate with an independent AI architect review performed by Claude Code.

supersedes_release_step.old: Obtain an independent human architect signature.
supersedes_release_step.new: Obtain a content-addressed independent AI architect approval from the exact allowlisted Claude Code reviewer.

release_rules: The original adjudication contract remains immutable and content-addressed; this amendment is an explicit scoped governance deviation.
The AI reviewer must be identified as AI and must never be represented by a human signature status.
Only the exact allowlisted reviewer role, product, model, and whole-file attestation SHA-256 are accepted; arbitrary AI or automated roles remain rejected.
The signed pairing-v3 projection may differ from the frozen unsigned candidate only in approved, reviewer_role, and reviewed_at.
The signed projection reviewer_role and reviewed_at must exactly match the anchored AI review attestation.
The signed projection whole-file SHA-256 and the AI review attestation whole-file SHA-256 must both be production trust anchors.
S6 may be marked done only after the signed release gate passes; S7 and the test window remain blocked until then.
